text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara and I are having a chat as we
make
our way back from an exhibition
race for an
event.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Aww, I lost again. But next time I'm
gonna win for
sure!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's do it!

She's always smiling, no matter how
many times
she loses. She always tries
her best and looks on
the brighter side
of things. I really want her to win
for
once.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't that the racer who placed last
today?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah. What's her name? Haru Urara,
right?

I think I can hear gossiping from far
away...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You think she held back because it's not
a real
race?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Nah, she always loses. She's never won
once since
her debut.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Wow. That's actually pretty amazing in
itself.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? They're talking about me!
Haru Urara rushes over to the gossipers.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you saw me race today, yeah? You
just
called me amazing, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: W-well, uh...

I catch up to her. Haru Urara is inches
away from
the gossiping man, who looks
like he's shriveling
up. Her eyes are
filled with sparkles...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heehee, it's true! I am amazing!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I love to run, but I don't usually go very
fast.
That's why I'm always losing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I-is that so...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But next time I'm gonna win for
really-reals! And
then you can say
"Wow, she won!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So, please come watch me again!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A and B
text_block_list.text: ...Sure.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm off! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A and B
text_block_list.text: Uh...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You know... I kinda want to cheer her on
now. She
seems like she tries really hard.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Same.

Fans are very important for an
Umamusume. Haru
Urara's natural talent
for gaining support will be a
huge boon
for her.

But, we still need to focus on getting her
some
wins. These thoughts race through
my mind as I
chase after her.
